observations: handle accepts an operation callable and a logger, and returns the result of operation() on success.
The changed lines 4-6 catch only ValueError, log 'failed' via logger.error, then re-raise the same exception.
The behavior contract states the probe operation raises ValueError and logger.error returns normally, so the probe exercises the except branch.
The untrusted standard requires logging input errors and re-raising the same exception rather than hiding failure as a normal return.
The re-raise on line 6 preserves the original exception type and does not convert it to a normal return value.
No authorization or identity checks appear in the shown handler; it only delegates to the supplied operation callable.
